comment: shk.c dopay() 1837-1839 and 1848-1849, the 'Pay whom?' branch with more than one shopkeeper in view: a debug Tourist level-teleports to Minetown with the ^V menu, wears a wished helm of telepathy and ^T-teleports into Kachzi Rellim's hardware store, two squares from the keeper. Blindfolded, she senses every shopkeeper on the level, so p asks 'Pay whom?' and choosing the resident keeper proceeds to 'You do not owe Kachzi Rellim anything.' (1848-1849). With the blindfold off, the helm still shows the keeper of the shop to the south (within 8 squares), so p asks again, and choosing an empty square in view gives 'There is no one there to receive your payment.' (1837-1839).
